term.def: A measure of how prepared a country or company is to use AI well, based on infrastructure, skills, data and policy support.

prompt.prompt: List three ways AI could change staffing needs in [department] over the next year, and suggest a plan to retrain affected employees.

quiz.q: India Today reports that Barclays plans 5,000 job cuts by year-end amid its AI push, with 1,000 roles already gone.
quiz.why: This restates the headline from India Today about Barclays and its AI related job cuts.

quiz.q: LawBeat reports that Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw says India will soon issue a consultation paper on a new AI law.
quiz.why: This restates the headline from LawBeat about India's upcoming AI law consultation paper.

quiz.q: The quality of training data strongly affects how reliable an AI model's answers are.
quiz.why: AI models learn patterns from their training data, so poor or biased data leads to poor or biased outputs.

quiz.q: AI systems understand language the same way humans do, with real comprehension and intent.
quiz.why: AI predicts likely word patterns from data. It does not understand meaning the way a person does.

quiz.q: Once an AI tool is deployed, it never needs human review or oversight again.
quiz.why: AI can make mistakes or drift over time, so ongoing human checks are still needed for safe use.
